about: The specimens the simulated microscope can mount and their targets (labelled structures), BSD-3-Clause. One registry for the engine (cli, viewer, webSMLM) and Micro-Manager: tools/gen_dye_library.mjs builds it into the C++ (DyeLibraryData.inc) and the JS (dye_library_data.js, web/dye_library.js). A target's 'prefix' names its engine options (<prefix>-dye, <prefix>-mode, <prefix>-label-pct, ...) and 'structure' its core structure id (ISC_STRUCT_*); its typical labels per mode are in data/dyes/library.json typicalLabels. 'paint' = its DNA-PAINT binding kinetics (a property of the docking/imager sequence, not of the dye): konPerMPerSec (imager association rate, /M/s; binding events per site per second = k_on x c) and onSec (mean bound time, exponential; half-time = ln 2 x onSec), the defaults of <prefix>-paint-kon and <prefix>-paint-on-sec. A new target: its core geometry, an entry here, its typical labels. A new specimen: its core generator, an entry here, a Micro-Manager device (spec/MM_DEVICES.md). The engine's 'specimen' option is the index here (core param 'specimen').

specimens.name: Cell field
specimens.notes: Adherent cells packed on a coverslip: cytoplasm, nucleus, microtubules (core/).

paint.notes: k_on: order of magnitude of 9-10 nt imagers (estimate; faster with optimized sequences, schueder2019). onSec 0.05 s (half-time 35 ms) keeps the pre-issue-16 default look (estimate); 9 nt docking strands bind for ~0.3-1 s.

specimens.name: DNA-origami nanorulers
specimens.notes: DNA-origami rods lying on a coverslip (the 80 nm nanoruler: a 200 x 13 nm rod with three spots of docking strands), bent in-plane as a worm-like chain (core/src/origami.*, data/origami/designs.json).

paint.notes: k_on as the microtubules' (estimate). onSec = 0.2 s / ln 2: a bound half-time of 200 ms (estimate, chosen 2026-10-12), in the order of 9 nt docking strands (~0.3-1 s mean).
